full_page.content:
1928, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 15 Cont. Mrs. W. Peters - Redford - Back-broken in 3 ( three) places and both legs. - things now brightening up.
Little girl with Meningitis
Frank Mercier - Blind - Operation one eye gone entirely Smolinski - 4 children - almost blind ...
Page 16
A Brother - out of Church married 10 years
Cancer of Breast & Neck - Mother of 7 - Dr. says only a few months to live. - Mrs. Lefebre, 5728 Wayburn
Not yet 14 year-old-boy takes out aunt's machine .... Excitement reigns ... Miss M.C. phones to Enroll in S.M.A .... Fr. S. Says boy will be home inside an hour ... comes in 15 minutes.
Sick Jewess - Gall Ed. Irlbacker - trying to sell - Albert O'Brien 2140 Concord - closed Autrum - Very Critical
Page 17 Mrs. D. E. Meyer, 1496 W. Grand Blvd. Kisses relique Wed. 28 March for her very sick brother. Going home she got a steak chop and cooked same. The boy was entirely changed - good appetite.
Sale of Property - asked Sabo - Von Speck - case - he not Cath. - folks breaking it up. Mrs. Angeline Cianciola 2 yrs. in bed - diabetes - roaring in Head - Heart trouble.
Nerveous - breakdown - Margaret Nestor - operation - cancer ??? No operation
Page 18
Miss Fogarty .. Fits, Fits, Fits! !
